newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to issue T$5 bln NCDs on Wednesday.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to issue T$5 bln NCDs on Wednesday.

text.p: Taiwan's central bank said on Wednesday it would issue T$5 billion in three-month negotiable certificates of deposit later in the day.
Bids would close at 15.00 local time (0700 GMT), a central bank official said.

During a sustained stock rally in March and April, the central bank repeatedly issued NCDs, a move widely seen as aiming to keep a lid on the loose liquidity that many experts said had been fuelling the then-sizzling stock market.
The central bank has confirmed that it was responding to the liquidity sitution but denied that it was acting directly in response to the stock market bull run.
The stock market in recent week has entered a consolidation, with daily turnover plunging to less than half of of the record levels set during the big rally.
